recipe.visualDefinition: A vertically split composition featuring a large, high-contrast typographic header on a solid black background in the upper two-thirds, and a horizontal rectangular photographic band portrait in the lower third.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between massive display type and small-scale photography
Color harmony between the golden-orange text and warm skin tones in the photo
Geometric tension between the solid black void and the detailed photographic strip
Vertical hierarchy moving from metadata to display title to subject imagery
coreInvariants: Solid black background for the top section
Horizontal letterbox-style photo frame at the bottom

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The photographic subject is confined to a narrow horizontal band at the bottom edge, while the text dominates the upper center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold display text serves as the primary visual anchor due to its scale and color contrast against the black.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top metadata, drops to the large title, and finally rests on the detailed group portrait at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive use of black negative space in the upper half to emphasize the typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright text and dark background; muted, natural saturation in the photo.
paletteRestrictions: Limit text to a single warm hue

letterConstructionRules: Significant stroke weight variation between thick and thin
Large x-height with tight letter spacing
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning causing slight overlaps in 'RT' and 'BA' pairs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the title paired with a minimal, tiny sans-serif for credits.
graphicDevices: Horizontal framing border for the photograph

avoid: Modernist geometric sans-serifs for the title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the soft yet bold 70s serif vibe
Matches the heavy weight and traditional serif structure
Provides the vintage, slightly weathered feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid black square canvas. In the bottom third, place a horizontal rectangular photograph of a group of men in 1970s casual attire (denim, button-downs, hats) standing in a soft-focus outdoor or draped setting with warm, natural lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a three-line centered title in the upper two-thirds using a bold, high-contrast serif font in a golden-orange color. Add a single line of tiny, white, wide-tracked sans-serif text at the very top edge.

verificationChecks: Is the text color a warm golden-orange?
Is the photo restricted to the bottom third of the frame?
Is the background above the photo solid black?
Is the title font a bold serif with tight spacing?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of gold/orange for the text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the photo does not bleed into the top two-thirds
Check that the serif font feels vintage rather than modern-digital
Verify the metadata text is small enough to be secondary
Confirm the drop shadow on the main text is extremely subtle
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid dark field + oversized vintage serif title + letterboxed subject photo at base.
